scope: Focused ScrapeView coverage for EXT-F-1007-T13 link open/copy/remove and href/text add forms. No product code changed.
evidence_level: Actual ScrapeView, CopyButton, and Zustand scrape store mounted in Vitest; only clipboard API and unrelated page/backend dependencies are stubbed. Anchor attributes and copy-boundary delivery are supporting component evidence, not proof that a browser tab opened or the OS clipboard changed.

open_and_copy.status: source/component pass with bounded open-link evidence
open_and_copy.evidence: The rendered anchor exposes the captured guide URL and target=_blank; CopyButton passes that exact URL to the mocked clipboard boundary; the real store remains unchanged. The test does not click the anchor or launch a browser tab.

remove.evidence: Removing the labeled seed guide leaves the exact unlabeled planting-calendar link including its rel value, changes the visible count from 2 links to 1 link, and removes only the selected row. A plant.py remove-all mutation failed this assertion with expected planting-calendar.pdf and received an empty list; plant.py restored src/state/scrape.ts byte-identically (sha 4861b5edb1dc).

add_href_and_text.evidence: A blank href is refused while the draft stays available. A valid href plus anchor text creates the exact expected link in the real store and increments the visible count. Cancel discards a later draft; reopening starts blank and preserves the exact surviving link set.

add_href_without_text.evidence: A valid href without anchor text creates a link with empty text and null rel; the UI uses the href as its label and reports the updated count.
